subject: Kickoff: compositional-generalization recipe card
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kicking off the training-recipe study. Base is our open-source "Making Transformers Solve Compositional Tasks" work: a systematic sweep over architectural choices — position encodings, copy decoders, weight sharing — showing that the right combination dramatically improves compositional generalization on SCAN, PCFG, COGS, and CFQ, plus the synthetic tasks (Addition, Reversing, Duplication and friends).

Why data-platforms owns it: every internal team training seq2seq models picks these knobs by folklore. Deliverable is a recipe card — evidence-backed defaults — published in the platform docs.

Milestones: harness ported off the notebooks by mid-March, main sweep April-May, recipe card by the 6/8 window close, with an extended repetition matrix continuing into July for statistical confidence.

Staffing and compute by early March?

Dmitri
